title: Hate Content Detection via Novel Pre-Processing Sequencing and Ensemble Methods
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical optimization of hate speech detection using machine learning classifiers (SVM, RF, etc.) and pre-processing sequences. While hate speech is a social and ethical issue, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical frameworks; it treats the task as a standard binary/multi-class classification problem in NLP.
